independence: Reviewer did not implement fixes and was instructed not to inspect independent corpora or communicate with corpus authors. Read-only review; no additional agents/models.
scope: Focused core code review and deterministic probes, not external human review, live-provider acceptance, or complete workspace validation.

findings.class: Indirect subject borrows adjacent launch predicate

A competitor to GLM 5.3 was launched in 2026.

findings.class: Explicit falsification supplies positive launch authority
reproductions: It is false that GLM 5.3 was launched in 2026.
The assertion that GLM 5.3 was launched in 2026 is false.

findings.class: Enclosing rejection still supplies made-available authority
reproductions: The vendor rejected the assertion that it has made GLM 5.3 generally available.

findings.class: Harmless leading date adjunct loses owned subject
reproductions: In 2026, Silver Lens became generally available.

findings.class: Month May treated as modal uncertainty
